```{r}
## load data
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

setwd("~/Desktop/UMass Workshop/Project") 

mydat <- st_read("final_df.geojson")
```


```{r}
fac <- read_excel("Column_Labels.xlsx", sheet = 3)
```

```{r}
View(fac)
```


```{r}
## Removing census tracts with invalid spatial coordinates
table(st_is_valid(mydat))

analysis.dat <- mydat[st_is_valid(mydat),]
```

```{r}
our_data <- analysis.dat %>%
  select(any_of(fac$Field))
```

```{r}
# Replace "NULL" with NA in every character column
our_data2 <- our_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.character),
    ~ na_if(., "NULL")
  ))
```

```{r}
# Keep columns that has NA less than 50% 
na_col <- colMeans(is.na(our_data2)) * 100
cols_to_drop <- names(na_col[na_col > 50])

clean_data <- our_data2 %>%
  select(-all_of(cols_to_drop))

cat("Dropped", length(cols_to_drop),
    "columns with >50% NA. Remaining columns:", ncol(clean_data), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Coerce all the columns to numeric
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = -geometry,
      .fns  = ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))    
    )
  )

summary(clean_data)
```
